name: Hag's Causeway
introText: Beyond the last of the burnt trees, the ground turns soft. The old road sinks into black water, and the water does not give things back. They call this place Hag's Causeway, though no one living has seen her. Here the dead do not stay buried.
finalLine: The Bog King sinks for the last time. The Causeway falls quiet.
